notes: One logical two-leg completed-week oil/gas close-location divergence reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, and density; neither leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA independently normalizes each leg's final close inside its synchronized completed-week range, trades only strict opposite outer-tercile states, fades the high-location leg, targets equal absolute notionals, and caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget.
